title: Kalkstein-Felssäule A
description: Geschichteter verjüngter Kalkstein-Monolith (~19 × 13 × 35 m) als 0-Credit-Kitbash aus cliff_chalk_wall_a und boulder_chalk_a mit klaren waagrechten Schichtbänken und asymmetrischem Sockelpfeiler. Farbe canyon_chalk #BCB296, Rauheit ≥ 0,68, 2,5 m Eingrabe-Rand.

review.notes: Monumental 17.8x11.9x34.7m asymmetric stratified chalk sea-stack with anchored boulder_chalk_a shoulder buttress, zero organ-pipe cylinders or floating debris, cohesive #BCB296 chalk and flint-grey horizontal bands matching cliff_chalk_wall_a/b, crisp closeup fractures without vertical stretching (slight crest pinch at very apex is acceptable), min_z=-2.5 verified, clean wire/clay and bakeable [24000,8000,2400] LODs.
